description:
Canonical TPC-H Q11 renders its value threshold as 0.0001 / SF (qgen does
this, and PR #770 made the SQL run path scale-faithful for both TPC-H and
TPC-Havoc). The DataFrame surface only gets the scale-correct fraction when a
qgen seed is provided: dataframe_runner._setup_parameter_overrides extracts
parameters from rendered qgen SQL and injects them via
set_parameter_overrides. Without a seed, every Q11 DataFrame implementation
(canonical TPC-H and all TPC-Havoc variants) reads
TPCH_DEFAULT_PARAMS[11]["fraction"] = 0.0001 - the SF=1 value - regardless of
the benchmark's actual scale factor. At SF=0.1 the executed Q11 threshold is
10x too small (wrong row count and timing); at SF=10 it is 10x too large.

The TPC-Havoc DataFrame equivalence gate
(benchbox/core/tpchavoc/dataframe_equivalence.py, see
tpchavoc-dataframe-variant-equivalence-gate) works around this inside the
gate by injecting {11: {"fraction": 0.0001 / SF}} through the same public
set_parameter_overrides seam that seeded runs use. That keeps the gate
honest but does not fix the unseeded product run path.

Fix at the seam where scale is known: the DataFrame runner (or the
parameter-override setup it calls) should derive the unseeded Q11 fraction
from the run's scale factor, exactly as the SQL side derives {q11_fraction}
during query rendering. Then drop the gate-local injection in
dataframe_equivalence.find_dataframe_divergences (the gate should pass with
no override once defaults are scale-aware).

preserves.behavior: Seeded runs keep using qgen-extracted parameters unchanged.
The TPC-Havoc DataFrame equivalence gate stays green throughout.

prior_art.concept: benchbox/core/runner/dataframe_runner.py:_setup_parameter_overrides - the seeded injection path; the unseeded path returns early when seed is None
benchbox/core/tpch/dataframe_queries.py:TPCH_DEFAULT_PARAMS / get_tpch_parameters / set_parameter_overrides - the parameter seam; defaults are static and scale-blind
benchbox/core/tpch/queries.py Q11 {q11_fraction} rendering (PR #770) - the SQL-side scale-faithfulness fix to mirror
benchbox/core/tpchavoc/dataframe_equivalence.py:find_dataframe_divergences - the gate-local workaround to remove once defaults are scale-aware

verifications.command: run TPC-H Q11 in DataFrame mode at SF=0.1 without a seed and compare to canonical SQL
verifications.description: Unseeded SF=0.1 DataFrame Q11 uses fraction 0.001
verifications.expected: row set matches canonical TPC-H Q11 at SF=0.1

work_units.notes:
When seed is None and benchmark_id is tpch (or a TPC-H-derived benchmark
such as tpchavoc), inject {11: {"fraction": 0.0001 / scale_factor}} via
set_parameter_overrides, or thread the scale factor into
get_tpch_parameters defaults. Keep seeded extraction authoritative when a
seed is present.
work_units.summary: Make the unseeded DataFrame Q11 fraction scale-aware at the runner seam

work_units.notes:
Drop the set_parameter_overrides injection in
find_dataframe_divergences; make tpchavoc-dataframe-equivalence-report
must still report 0 divergent cells at SF=0.1, proving the product path
is scale-faithful on its own.
work_units.summary: Remove the gate-local Q11 override and re-verify the DataFrame gate
